rules.fetch_mechanism: REVISER STAGE MADE NO NEW FETCHES. All evidence is inherited from the declared source_roots (research + critic stages) and retained byte-identical (sha256-verified) in reviser/sources/. Reviser-side observed operations were read/grep/copy verification of retained excerpts only — no HTTP, no binaries, no account/config changes.
rules.accessed_at_note: access timestamps are the ORIGINAL fetch times recorded by the upstream stage that fetched each source (inherited unchanged; inheritance is explicit, not a silent rebinding of evidence)
